question: Consider the parabola $y^2=4x$. Let $P$ and $Q$ be the points $(4,-4)$ and $(9,6)$ of the parabola. Let $R$ be a moving point on the arc of the parabola between $P$ and $Q$. Then the area of the triangle $RPQ$ is largest when
